exercises.title: Provision an isolated resource group
exercises.objective: Create a tagged resource boundary and verify policy inheritance.
exercises.validation: Resource Graph returns the expected tags and location.

exercises.title: Build a segmented virtual network
exercises.objective: Create workload and management subnets with non-overlapping CIDRs.
exercises.validation: Effective routes show only the intended address spaces.

exercises.title: Author least-privilege NSG rules
exercises.objective: Allow bounded administration while denying unsolicited inbound traffic.
exercises.validation: Network Watcher flow verify reports the expected decisions.

exercises.title: Deploy a Linux administration VM
exercises.objective: Create a key-only Linux host without embedding secrets in configuration.
exercises.validation: Fresh SSH session succeeds and password login is rejected.

exercises.title: Harden the SSH daemon
exercises.objective: Disable root and password login while preserving tested recovery access.
exercises.validation: sshd configuration test passes before service reload.
exercises.command: sudo sshd -t && sudo systemctl reload ssh

exercises.title: Configure automatic security updates
exercises.objective: Apply a controlled unattended-upgrades policy with reboot visibility.
exercises.validation: Dry run reports only approved security origins.

exercises.title: Inspect systemd service failure
exercises.objective: Correlate unit status, exit code and journal evidence before restarting.
exercises.validation: Service recovers and journal shows a clean start.

exercises.title: Capture disk-pressure evidence
exercises.objective: Identify filesystem, inode and largest-directory pressure without deleting data.
exercises.validation: Evidence bundle identifies a bounded cleanup candidate.

exercises.title: Create an Entra service principal
exercises.objective: Create an application identity with an explicit owner and purpose.
exercises.validation: Sign-in and audit logs show the expected application identity.

exercises.title: Rotate a service-principal credential
exercises.objective: Overlap old and new credentials to avoid an authentication outage.
exercises.validation: New credential succeeds before the old credential is revoked.

exercises.title: Assign resource-scoped RBAC
exercises.objective: Grant a built-in role at the narrowest practical Azure scope.
exercises.validation: Access succeeds at target scope and is denied outside it.

exercises.title: Review effective role assignments
exercises.objective: Trace inherited and direct assignments for a support identity.
exercises.validation: Unexpected inheritance is documented and removed through approval.

exercises.title: Stage Conditional Access in report-only
exercises.objective: Test MFA and device controls against a pilot group before enforcement.
exercises.validation: Sign-in logs show expected decisions and break-glass exclusions.

exercises.title: Link a private DNS zone
exercises.objective: Resolve a private endpoint from the workload VNet.
exercises.validation: Two independent resolvers return the private address and TTL.
exercises.command: az network private-dns link vnet create --registration-enabled false

exercises.title: Trace an asymmetric route
exercises.objective: Compare effective routes and next hops in both traffic directions.
exercises.validation: Connection troubleshoot reports a symmetric allowed path.

exercises.title: Test TCP and TLS reachability
exercises.objective: Separate DNS, TCP handshake and TLS negotiation failures.
exercises.validation: Evidence identifies the failing layer without exposing secrets.

exercises.title: Configure Log Analytics ingestion
exercises.objective: Send Linux system telemetry through a data-collection rule.
exercises.validation: A known host heartbeat appears within the stated window.

exercises.title: Author a KQL service-health query
exercises.objective: Summarize error rate and latency by service and deployment version.
exercises.validation: Query output matches a controlled test event.

exercises.title: Create an actionable alert rule
exercises.objective: Configure threshold, evaluation window and owner-facing context.
exercises.validation: A controlled test fires once and resolves automatically.
exercises.command: az monitor metrics alert create --condition 'avg Percentage CPU > 80'

exercises.title: Validate an action-group notification
exercises.objective: Confirm the right receiver and escalation channel are active.
exercises.validation: Test notification reaches the documented owner.

exercises.title: Write the Terraform network module
exercises.objective: Represent network boundaries as reviewable infrastructure code.
exercises.validation: terraform validate and plan complete with no unintended replacement.
exercises.command: terraform fmt -check && terraform validate && terraform plan

exercises.title: Protect remote Terraform state
exercises.objective: Use locking, encryption and restricted data-plane access.
exercises.validation: Concurrent plan is blocked and authorized plan succeeds.

exercises.title: Build a redacting diagnostics script
exercises.objective: Capture DNS, route, TCP and HTTP evidence while masking IPv4 addresses.
exercises.validation: Output contains hashes and no unredacted test addresses.

exercises.title: Create a GitHub Actions quality gate
exercises.objective: Check Terraform formatting, shell syntax and documentation coverage.
exercises.validation: A deliberate formatting defect fails the workflow.

exercises.title: Rotate a Key Vault secret
exercises.objective: Version a secret, update the consumer and verify audit evidence.
exercises.validation: Consumer uses new version and old version is disabled after confirmation.

exercises.title: Inspect Defender recommendations
exercises.objective: Prioritize a security recommendation by exposure and operational impact.
exercises.validation: Remediation evidence closes the recommendation without new alerts.

exercises.title: Run a certificate-expiry check
exercises.objective: Extract certificate subject, issuer and remaining validity.
exercises.validation: Alert threshold matches the documented renewal window.
exercises.command: echo | openssl s_client -connect example.com:443 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates

exercises.title: Execute a rollback rehearsal
exercises.objective: Practice restoring known-good configuration within an approved window.
exercises.validation: Service, logs, dependency checks and user path all recover.

exercises.title: Assemble an incident evidence bundle
exercises.objective: Package timeline, commands, redacted outputs and checksums for escalation.
exercises.validation: Reviewer can reproduce the reasoning without privileged access.

exercises.title: Complete a recovery verification matrix
exercises.objective: Test authentication, authorization, network, service, data and telemetry paths.
exercises.validation: Every recovery claim maps to an observed result and owner.

incidents.rootCause: Higher-priority deny rule shadowed the intended allow
incidents.fix: Corrected priority and verified Network Watcher flow plus fresh SSH

incidents.rootCause: Private DNS zone was not linked to workload VNet
incidents.fix: Linked VNet and compared resolver answers from two subnets

incidents.rootCause: Role assignment used the wrong resource scope
incidents.fix: Re-scoped least privilege and verified audit event

incidents.rootCause: Action-group receiver was disabled
incidents.fix: Enabled receiver and confirmed a controlled test alert

incidents.rootCause: Environment file contained an invalid endpoint
incidents.fix: Restored known-good configuration and validated dependency reachability

incidents.rootCause: Old kernel packages and journal retention consumed disk
incidents.fix: Applied bounded cleanup and confirmed inode and disk headroom

incidents.rootCause: Break-glass exclusion was omitted from pilot policy
incidents.fix: Restored exclusion and reviewed sign-in result matrix

incidents.symptom: Terraform plan held an orphaned lock
incidents.rootCause: Interrupted runner did not release remote state lease
incidents.fix: Verified no active job then removed the exact lock ID

incidents.rootCause: SNAT ports exhausted during batch processing
incidents.fix: Added NAT Gateway and validated concurrent connections

incidents.rootCause: Gateway served an incomplete certificate chain
incidents.fix: Uploaded full chain and validated SNI negotiation

incidents.rootCause: NTP source was unreachable through egress policy
incidents.fix: Allowed approved source and verified chrony tracking

incidents.rootCause: Data-collection rule association was removed
incidents.fix: Restored association and confirmed fresh heartbeat

incidents.rootCause: Resource owner approval was not completed
incidents.fix: Approved connection and verified private resolution

incidents.symptom: SSH key worked for one user only
incidents.rootCause: Home-directory permissions prevented key loading
incidents.fix: Corrected ownership and validated two fresh sessions

incidents.symptom: Azure CLI token expired in automation
incidents.rootCause: Long-running job exceeded access-token lifetime
incidents.fix: Switched to workload identity and verified renewal

incidents.symptom: Route to database used internet next hop
incidents.rootCause: User-defined route was missing from workload subnet
incidents.fix: Associated route table and confirmed effective route

incidents.symptom: Container could not read Key Vault
incidents.rootCause: Managed identity federated credential subject mismatched
incidents.fix: Corrected subject and validated secret access audit

incidents.rootCause: Hostname changed while old agent identity remained
incidents.fix: Retired stale resource and normalized computer identity

incidents.symptom: Deployment passed but health check failed
incidents.rootCause: Application listened on a different container port
incidents.fix: Aligned probe and service port then verified rollout

incidents.rootCause: Diagnostic logs used an unbounded retention setting
incidents.fix: Applied retention policy and validated export requirement

incidents.symptom: RBAC removal did not revoke access
incidents.rootCause: User retained access through nested group membership
incidents.fix: Traced transitive membership and removed approved grant

incidents.rootCause: Resolver cache retained the previous long TTL
incidents.fix: Reduced TTL before change and verified after expiry

incidents.rootCause: Egress policy blocked package repository access
incidents.fix: Allowed required service tag and reran extension

incidents.symptom: Backup job succeeded without restore point
incidents.rootCause: Policy targeted a resource group that excluded the VM
incidents.fix: Corrected scope and performed test restore

incidents.rootCause: Suppression window was shorter than ingestion delay
incidents.fix: Adjusted window and validated a single incident

incidents.rootCause: Guest firewall denied the management subnet
incidents.fix: Added bounded source rule and tested session

incidents.rootCause: Package upgrade changed required file permissions
incidents.fix: Restored ownership and added post-patch validation

incidents.rootCause: Consumer pinned a disabled Key Vault version
incidents.fix: Removed version pin and tested managed identity retrieval

incidents.rootCause: Storage destination firewall denied the collector
incidents.fix: Added trusted service exception and verified ingestion

incidents.symptom: Recovery change fixed API but not users
incidents.rootCause: Frontend cached stale service discovery data
incidents.fix: Invalidated cache and verified complete user journey
